verdict.rationale: The engine is documented as open-source (playcanvas-gh-6) and free to install via npm (playcanvas-gh-2/gh-5), implying no per-install engine fees, but the evidence never states the specific license (e.g., MIT) or explicitly confirms 'no royalties on game revenue.' Paid cloud plans exist for hosting/private projects (playcanvas-docs-10, comm-6), which is a separate SaaS cost, not a royalty, but this nuance isn't clarified in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit license name/terms, explicit royalty-free statement, clarification that paid plans are unrelated to game revenue.
